# Warea sessilifolia

Warea sessilifolia is a species of flowering plant in the Warea genus. It grows in the Florida panhandle, Alabama, and Georgia. An annual dicot, ifs common name is sessileleaf pinelandcress. It produces dark pink flowers and narrow curved fruit pods. It grows up to 3 feet high. Its name sessilifolia refers to its stemless leaves.
